import builtins
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest


def log_line(level: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Print `[level] message` to standard output.

    Console only: must not open, create, or write any file.
    """
    print(f"[{level}] {message}")


def test_log_line_basic(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "started")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[INFO] started\n"
    assert captured.err == ""


def test_log_line_returns_none(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    fn: Any = log_line
    assert fn("WARN", "disk low") is None
    capsys.readouterr()


def test_log_line_preserves_case(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("debug", "MiXeD Case")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[debug] MiXeD Case\n"


def test_log_line_empty_message(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] \n"


def test_log_line_empty_level(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("", "hello")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[] hello\n"


def test_log_line_special_characters(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("ERROR", "bad [value] {x} 100% é")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[ERROR] bad [value] {x} 100% é\n"


def test_log_line_single_line_per_call(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "one")
    log_line("INFO", "two")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] one\n[INFO] two\n"


def test_log_line_does_not_touch_filesystem(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    def forbidden(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        raise AssertionError("log_line must not touch the file system")

    monkeypatch.setattr(builtins, "open", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "open", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "write_text", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "write_bytes", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)

    log_line("INFO", "no files please")

    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] no files please\n"
    assert list(tmp_path.iterdir()) == []
